text.en:
Start with a sentence you can say today.
Ich bin hier. = I am here.
Ich means “I”. Hier means “here”.
Bin means “am”. It sits in the middle, like in English.
Ich bin müde. = I am tired.
Müde means “tired”. Change the last word, keep the rest.

Say who, and the middle word changes.
Ich bin hier. = I am here.
Du bist hier. = You are here.
Anna ist hier. = Anna is here.
Wir sind hier. = We are here.
English does this too: I am, you are, she is.
German uses bin, bist, ist, sind.

You will see a sentence in English.
Tap the German words one by one.
After each tap, the next choices appear.
Die Kinder sind bereit. = The children are ready.
Die means “the”. Kinder means “children”. Bereit means “ready”.
You do not need commas or full stops.
